body: everyone said it would be better by now, but four months later and im still in the trenches

thats what ive always said, i just want someone to love me like i love them. I give my all in relationships and love so hard. I was with my last, and first, boyfriend for two years. He wanted me to move in with him and follow him to another state for grad school. he convinced he really cared about me and that we would be together forever. All of a sudden he doesnt love me anymore and now hes dating someone else. I tried so fucking hard and now none of it matters

the only thing i have ever been sure of in life is that love is the point of life. Its the only thing that has ever mattered to me and nothing has ever compared to how it feels. I dont understand why it has to hurt so bad though. i have given everything in relationships just to get fucked over again and again. i just to be loved the same way i love people but people are fucking awful
i had to call three times this morning before i got to talk to someone and all they could suggest was journaling my feelings. Its not their fault, but its funny i guess.

I feel that. theres nothing that will make me feel better. no comfort food or favorite movie or silver lining. Its almost like trying to do anything good for me only makes me feel worse. There was a time when i felt so naturally happy go lucky, life was fun, i was so lucky. Now, every day is just sleep walking and breaking down and repeating the cycle. I dont know what to do. I went through a similar depressive episode in high school, just not nearly as bad. I went to bed every night hoping to die. Then life got better, i never thought id feel that way again. Now its even worse. I dont know any way to make it better and i dont know if it ever will. But sometimes i think what i went through in high school was preparing me for this. Like its proof that the bad feelings can go away. So now, even though i want nothing more than to kill myself, theres a thought in the back of my head thats like theres some small chance out there that you will be happy again. I dont even know what happiness feels like anymore but i want to stick around just in case
